name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 16, 2014 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Board Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar. The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
S8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 3/26/14 Special Joint Meeting and the 3/19/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the minutes.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S8A Minutes
S8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S8B Warrants
S8C.
San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Accept San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S8C Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis
S8D.
Consideration to Approve "In-Concept" an Annexation of 7.1 Acres of Property Located off Quail Gardens Drive into the San Dieguito Water District Service Area from the Olivenhain Municipal Water District. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Approve "In-Concept" an annexation of 7.1 Acres of property located off Quail Gardens Drive into the San Dieguito Water District Service Area from the Olivenhain Municipal Water District and authorize staff to proceed with the annexation process.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S8D Annexation Quail Meadows
S8E.
Adoption of Resolution 2014-04, authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records in accordance with San Dieguito Water District retention guidelines and pursuant to Government Code. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2014-04, authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S8E SDWD Destruction of Records
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Discussion and Direction on San Dieguito Water District's Recycled Water Program. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
1) Receive a presentation on efforts to increase recycled water use, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate; and 2) Authorize an amount not to exceed $200,000 from the Capital Reserve Fund to provide loans for converting potable water use sites to recycled water.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S10A Discussion of Recycled Water Program
10B.
Report on Enhancing San Dieguito Water District Public Outreach by Utilizing Bill Inserts. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Receive the report and provide direction to staff as necessary.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S10B Bill Inserts
10C.
Consider a License Agreement with Rancho Coastal Humane Society Regarding Use of a Portion of the District's Requeza Yard Property. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Approve a License Agreement with Rancho Coastal Humane Society regarding use of a portion of the District's Requeza Yard property.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S10C Requeza Yard License - Humane Society
10D.
Refunding of San Dieguito Water District's 2004 Water Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series A. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
1) Approve the refinancing plan for the 2004 Water Revenue Refunding Bonds; 2) Direct the General Manager to execute professional services agreements with: (a) Fieldman Rolapp and Associates as Financial Advisor, and (b) Best, Best and Krieger as Bond and Disclosure Counsel; and 3) Direct the General Manager to authorize the payment of any/all non-contingent out-of-pocket expenses incurred in the issuance of the New Bonds, unless such costs are paid out of the proceeds of the New Bond issue.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S10D Bond Refunding
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational Presentation on Drought and Water Supply Conditions. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
District Board receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S11A Drought and Water Supply Conditions
11B.
Informational Presentation on 2014 National Mayor's Challenge for Water Conservation. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
District Board receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2014-04-16 SDWD Item #S11B National Mayor's Challenge for Water
S12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY BOARD MEMBERS
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S13.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S15.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
